title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs bug fix and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for a bug fix and enhancement update to Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs, specifically including qt6 packages. The update addresses issues related to CVE-2026-105923 and CVE-2026-95620. No explicit details about the vulnerability or exploit methods are provided. The advisory lists updated qt6 RPM packages across multiple architectures.
